'''Shellshy''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Boldclaw]] at 6 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "You might think the shell Shellshy bought is small, but the clerk at Shellbucks insisted it's a medium. Shellshy was too chicken to argue."

Shellshy is an early game, blue rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
An orange hermit crab with a non-visible body. It has a pointed light blue shell with slightly darker spikes around it. Its eyes peek out from the darkness of the shell. 

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: It thinks the shell it bought is small, but the clerk at Shellbucks insisted its a medium.
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: With a larger-than-body shell, Shellshy can safely retreat inside and hide behind pincers when in danger.

==Strategy==
[[File:Shellshy Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Shellshy's attack range]]
Good early game tank. Works well with any backliners, but pairs well with [[Droppit]] and its evolutions due to their slowing abilities.
